desc: Overlay `str2` at every `'T'` index and detect conflicting assignments.
Classify each `'F'` window and attach unresolved constraints to its rightmost free-position deadline.
Implement left-to-right lexicographic greedy assignment with unsatisfiable-character detection.
Establish why deadline constraints suffice and why the smallest feasible character is lexicographically optimal.
Run comprehensive correctness and edge-case tests, including provided examples and overlap-heavy patterns.
